thread:
lee_support: pinging eng on behalf of Streamlytics — their per-model QPS tiles in Console dropped to a flat zero for a handful of models around 08:00 UTC. Their backend traces show normal traffic.

anya_eng-platform: can you paste the dashboard URL and the panel query?

lee_support: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/org/streamlytics/models
Panel query (Grafana):
```
sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_inference_qps_total[5m]))
```
Customer ran the same and says the rows for models like "gpt-4r-heavy" are missing.

customer_streamlytics: confirmed: dashboards show zeroes but our API metrics & traces are normal. Billing looks fine.

dina_eng-sre: rolling history: infra deployed exporter-v2.3 at 06:42 UTC which standardized labels. We replaced label key `model_id` with `model_name` on the model exporters. Metric name unchanged. deploy-bot: exporter-v2.3 @ 2026-03-15T06:42:12Z

anya_eng-platform: that matches. Dashboards still group by `model_id` so any exporter that now emits `model_name` will be invisible to that query. Two immediate options: 1) add a Prometheus recording rule to copy `model_name` -> `model_id` for compatibility; 2) update Console panels to prefer `model_name` (and fallback to `model_id`).

matt_product: what's the blast radius? Are other systems impacted (billing, alerts)?

dina_eng-sre: billing uses aggregated counter metrics (by metric name) and doesn't depend on per-model keys — billing unaffected. Alerts that explicitly filter on `model_id` will miss targets; we need to enumerate dashboards and alerts.

anya_eng-platform: I'll prepare a short-term recording rule using label_replace so dashboards keep working. Example expr: 
```
label_replace(sum by (model_name) (rate(redwood_inference_qps_total[5m])), "model_id", "$1", "model_name", "(.*)")
```
We'll promote to prod after staging smoke.

dina_eng-sre: pushing compat rule to staging now. Also adding an infra changelog entry documenting the label rename and the required migrations.

lee_support: shared repro steps with customer so they can validate:
1) `sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_inference_qps_total[5m]))` -> missing rows
2) `sum by (model_name) (rate(redwood_inference_qps_total[5m]))` -> shows expected values

customer_streamlytics: thanks — saw rows with model_name. Would like dashboards restored; not a critical outage but prefer fix within 4 hours.

ops-bot: rules-manager: uploaded "compat-model-labels" to staging by dina_eng-sre @ 2026-03-15T08:20:05Z

dina_eng-sre: promoted compat recording rule to prod at 08:55 UTC. Smoke check: `sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_inference_qps_total[5m]))` now returns gpt-4r-heavy rows again.

ops-bot: rules-manager: deployed recording rule group "compat-model-labels" to prod by dina_eng-sre @ 2026-03-15T08:55:13Z

anya_eng-platform: opened PR #4821 to update Console panels to prefer `model_name` and fall back to `model_id`. Also adding a migration guide for self-hosted customers. Plan to ship in next maintenance window.

lee_support: Customer confirmed graphs are back to normal after the compat rule. They've requested a short postmortem and a notification plan for any future label changes. Assigning follow-up to eng-platform + SRE.

matt_product: please include a list of dashboards/alerts/panels that reference `model_id` so we can proactively migrate and notify customers.

lee_support: will collate and send list separately. Closing thread once follow-up ticket created.

-- thread closed --
